company.name: TiDB Powered by PingCAP
company.shortDescription: TiDB powered by PingCAP (the company) is an AI-native distributed SQL database platform for agentic workloads with elastic autoscaling.
company.description: TiDB powered by PingCAP (the company) is the distributed SQL database built for AI agents. AI-native companies, leading SaaS providers, and global enterprises run TiDB to support workloads that traditional databases cannot, including millions of tables, persistent agent state, high-concurrency reads and writes, frequent schema changes, and zero-downtime scaling at petabyte scale. With AI-driven innovations across the platform and multi-cloud flexibility, TiDB delivers the resilience, performance, and security organizations need for modern applications. Headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, TiDB serves customers worldwide. Learn more at TiDB.io.

productsAndServices.description: An open-source, MySQL-compatible distributed SQL database for transactional, analytical, vector-search, and AI workloads with horizontal scalability and strong ACID consistency.
productsAndServices.name: TiDB

productsAndServices.description: A fully managed, cloud-native TiDB service with autoscaling, durable object storage, automated operations, high availability, and support for transactional, analytical, vector, and AI workloads.
productsAndServices.name: TiDB Cloud

productsAndServices.description: A self-hosted deployment of TiDB that gives organizations control over infrastructure, networking, security, data locality, configuration, and upgrade operations.
productsAndServices.name: TiDB Self-Managed

productsAndServices.description: Guided services and tools for assessing, migrating, optimizing, and operating MySQL and other SQL workloads on TiDB.
productsAndServices.name: TiDB Migration and Technical Support Services
